scoring_justification: Recomputing efficiency and P/T from raw simulation and reconstruction outputs is infeasible in the verifier; the agent reports final metrics which are compared to paper-derived reference values with tolerant thresholds and structural ordering checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold metrics for the three figures-of-merit and Compton profile effect.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from paper Figure 1 (Mγ=5, σpos=1 mm, 1332 keV γ rays) and Figure 6 (Compton effect at Mγ=25 scaled to Mγ=5 context). The reference solve.sh encodes the same values.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual reading from the published figure; tolerances chosen to be generous (+0.05 for ε, +0.10 for P/T) to absorb implementation differences while preserving the stated conclusion that w3_step is best and Compton profile degrades performance.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual quantitative conclusions reported in the paper; the checker enforces that the agent's reproduction matches the paper's findings within expected run-to-run variation.

outputs.description: JSON file containing the computed photopeak efficiency and peak-to-total ratio for each figure-of-merit and for the atomic Compton profile effect.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the reported metrics against the paper's published values using generous tolerances and verify the relative ordering w3_step > w2_step > w1_step for both ε and P/T. For the Compton profile effect, it will verify that the 'with_compton' values are lower than 'without_compton'.

steps.description: Validates that the JSON file exists, is valid, and contains the required top-level keys.
Verifies that w3_step > w2_step > w1_step for both epsilon and P_over_T.
Verifies that for the same metric, with_compton < without_compton (degradation).
Scores the absolute epsilon values against paper-derived gold; values at or above (gold - tol) receive full credit, lower values receive proportional credit.
Scores the absolute P/T values; values at or above (gold - tol) receive full credit.
Scores epsilon for the Compton profile effect cases.
Scores P/T for the Compton profile effect cases.
